answer: A scripted farm as a result has to pad 99 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is recorded against the thread challenge, the vertex audit can replay the willow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 4892 identities would post 3880 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
